label: pjm 50 seam firm
definition: (DIAGNOSTIC) pjm 48 coal keeper + pjm 49 seam-price corrections + THREE grounded reference-price seam additions targeting the MISO/NYISO under-export pjm 49 unmasked. (1) FIRM SCHEDULED-EXPORT FLOOR (firm_export_floor_by_year + inject_reference_price_firm_export): force the cheapest export tranches on at the p10 of PJM's OWN per-tie SCHEDULED export (MISO 1250/100/0, NYISO 900/1400/1650 MW), the export mirror of the Manitoba/HQ firm-import floors -- the firm contractual base that flows regardless of the hourly spread (rule #11: scheduled-transaction data, not the realized actual_flow that is scored). (2) HURDLE 2.0->1.0: physical decomposition -- the firm transmission-service half of the old OMS-RSC $2 is now carried by the firm floor, leaving marginal losses (~3% x ~$35 ~= $1) as the only friction on the economic increment (PJM-MISO/NYISO JOAs pay no pancaked wheeling). (3) TVA + LGEE import seams (~8 TWh/yr, previously unmodeled): documented Southeast SERC $30/MWh basis (HR 11.6, like reconciled Carolinas), limits 1600/1100 MW from p99.5 of PJM's measured ties. Net-interchange MAE vs EIA-930 15.2 (pjm 49 16.5); vs per-tie sum 10.4.
